name: John Grotberg
bio: A Representative from Illinois; born in Winnebago, Minn., March 23, 1925; graduated from Valley City High School, Valley City, N.D.; attended University of Chicago; B.S., George Williams College, 1961; corporate Director of Financial Development, YMCA of Metropolitan Chicago; Illinois State representative, 1973-1977; Illinois State senator, 1977-1985; elected as a Republican to the Ninety-ninth Congress and served until his death on November 15, 1986 (January 3, 1985- November 15, 1986); died on November 15, 1986, in Saint Charles, Ill.; interment in Union Cemetery, Saint Charles, Ill.
